title: Timmask Spores (ingredient)
summary: Extract three spores for Fungal Bamboozler or give one to Omeluum.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Timmask Spores into Essence of Timmask Spores, then add any Salt to make Fungal Bamboozler.
fields.Quest use: Omeluum asks for 1 spore and 1 Tongue of Madness for Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
